verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a full-featured Gemini mobile app with rich functionality (Gemini Live voice conversations, screen-aware Android assistant via 'Hey Google', Maps/Flights integration, daily briefs, scheduling, image generation, coding help) showing strong Android support, and generic mobile-app language implies broader availability, but the evidence never explicitly names or details an iOS app or iOS-specific parity. missing for 10: explicit iOS app documentation/feature parity, App Store presence, and any cross-platform comparison confirming equal functionality on iOS vs Android.
